post:
  operationId: post.workspaces.time-off.requests
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-030000-post.workspaces.time-off.requests-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    This is a LIST endpoint using POST (per CLAUDE.md: 'Time-off request listing
    is POST, not GET'). clockify_time_off_requests_list POSTs a JSON search body
    {page, pageSize, statuses?:[], users?:[]} and receives {count:int,
    requests:[]object}. Live call returned 2 real PENDING requests. Source:
    time_off_requests.go:44-52. GET to this path returns 405.
  x-truth-iter: iter19
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            page: {type: integer}
            pageSize: {type: integer}
            statuses:
              type: array
              items: {type: string}
            users:
              type: array
              items: {type: string}
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Paginated envelope {count:int, requests:[]}
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              count: {type: integer}
              requests:
                type: array
                items: {type: object}
endpoints.notes: List endpoint disguised as POST. Body is a filter/search object. Real data returned: 2 PENDING requests. Distinct from /policies/{policyId}/requests creation path.

discrepancies.description: Path is listed in raw_allowlist_gen.go but GET probe returns Spring-MVC 404 'No static resource' — route does not exist in live Clockify API. User-filtered listing is served by POST /workspaces/{wId}/time-off/requests with users:[] filter body, not a separate /requests/users/{userId} route.
